description: Floating Car Data is a dataset listed in transportdata.be, a national access point for transport data, published or maintained by Be-Mobile. FCD or Floating Car Data is the label for GPS positions that are received from so called FCD providers. The GPS data is mapped onto the digital map and provided as feed for various Be-Mobile applications. For instance, the data can be aggregated per map segment to calculate the occurrence of jams. Coverage: Belgium (see the dataset page for the exact area). The portal lists 1 resource in MSG_HTTP. The data standards named are other. The national access point types are RTTI. The portal shows 2025-07-08 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is notspecified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support mobility and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-transportdata-be-national-access-point.
